scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramik Awas Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Registered construction workers must have continuous live registration for at least three years.
No existing residence in Chhattisgarh in the worker's or family members' names.
Only one beneficiary per household can receive the subsidy.
Maximum land area allowed is 500 sq ft in urban areas and 1,000 sq ft in rural areas.
Housing construction on government‑leased land is permissible.
Selected property should not be under any dispute.
Land diversion or building permit from the concerned Chhattisgarh government department is required if the worker owns land or is purchasing a new house.
benefits_summary: Registered construction workers can receive a subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for interest payments on housing loans.
